signature.name: VTask.inductionOn
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {C : {n : ℕ} → List.Vector α n → Sort u_6} -> {n : ℕ} -> (v : List.Vector α n) -> (nil : C List.Vector.nil) -> (cons : {n : ℕ} → {x : α} → {w : List.Vector α n} → C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)) -> C v

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total with no junk inputs; all arguments are well-typed by construction and no special edge-value conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {C : ∀ {n : ℕ}, List.Vector α n → Sort*} {n : ℕ} (x : α) (w : List.Vector α n) (b : C List.Vector.nil) (s : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : α} {w : List.Vector α n}, C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)), VTask.inductionOn (x ::ᵥ w) b s = s (VTask.inductionOn w b s)
